reviews.text:
This was my first time using their daytime daycare service.

I had been curious about this place for a while, but I was worried about whether my dog ​​would get used to it. However, they sent me a video update showing how much fun my dog ​​was having, which put my mind at ease.

The staff were very kind and explained everything clearly, which left a great impression! I will definitely visit again!

I received very courteous service. They cut my dog's fur while considering the flow and characteristics of his hair, and I am very happy with the result. They also sent me photos and videos of my dog ​​during grooming, which gave me peace of mind knowing that he was relaxed. I felt confident in the personalities and service of all the staff, and I would like to use their hotel services again in the future, so I made a reservation on the spot.

I used to go to the Azabu-Juban branch, but I switched to this one because it's closer to my home. ^_^
My dogs seem to be having a great time♪
The staff are very trustworthy.
There are cameras and logs that owners can see, so I can keep track of how my dogs are doing and feel at ease!
I'd like to use their grooming services in the future.

I was planning to leave my 11-year-old dog at a pet hotel, and because she's an older dog, I requested daytime care in advance.

During her stay, they kept me updated on her well-being with detailed and careful communication, which made me feel very at ease. After dropping her off, they created a daily log and photo album on my LINE account, which gave me a clear picture of how she spent her day, and I was very happy about that.

I could feel the meticulous care and kindness of all the staff, and I thought, "I can leave my dog ​​here with peace of mind." I feel confident entrusting her to them for an overnight stay as well. Thank you very much! 🌼

I visited your shop for the first time the other day.

The shop was neat and clean, and the staff who greeted me, as well as the groomer in charge, explained everything carefully.

Thank you for the thorough explanations beforehand, when I picked up my dog, and how my dog ​​was doing while being cared for. You welcomed my dog ​​warmly, and I felt completely at ease.

I would definitely like to use your services again next time! ✨

Thank you for the trial lesson. The staff were all incredibly kind and attentive, and I was surprised by their excellent teamwork, especially considering they've only recently opened.

They answered all my concerns and anxieties accurately, making me feel confident leaving my dog ​​in their care. They also send many photos, which gives me peace of mind knowing how my dog ​​is doing during the school.

The free-roaming environment is a major plus; my dog ​​can have fun, release energy, and come back feeling less stressed.

Furthermore, the ability to request grooming during the school is incredibly helpful. Knowing that I can check on my dog ​​via camera during hotel stays also gives me peace of mind.

This is a wonderful school that I would definitely like to use again in the future.

I used the 3-hour daycare service 🐶✨

My dog ​​got to play a lot in the dog run, and they sent me detailed updates with photos and videos, which made me feel at ease leaving him there. ☺️
They also wrote a daily log, which was great because I could easily see how he was doing!

I would definitely like to use their service again 🐾

I was concerned about my dog's pulling and restlessness during walks, so I participated in a play school trial.

After the trial, they provided a detailed report of the day's events with photos and a log, which gave me a clear understanding of how my dog ​​spent the day and put my mind at ease. The trainer also clearly explained the current situation and future challenges, which made me feel very confident in their abilities.

I decided to enroll my dog ​​in the play school because I felt they would provide meticulous, individualized instruction. I'm looking forward to my dog ​​becoming a better walker.

I'm very excited to see his progress.

I requested daytime childcare as a trial before my hotel stay. The staff provided a thorough consultation beforehand, which put my dog ​​at ease. The staff were very kind, and my dog ​​seemed to enjoy being pampered.

Thank you for the videos, pictures, and daily log; I enjoyed looking at them. Thank you for taking such good care of my dog.

I requested a shampoo for my dog. The service was very thorough, and both my family and my dog ​​were very satisfied. They even sent videos and photos before the grooming started, during the grooming, and after it was finished, which made me feel confident leaving my dog ​​in their care. Thank you very much.

This was my dog's second grooming session. Last time, she had loose stools for a while after returning home, possibly due to stress, but this time she came back healthy and happy. The photos show her enjoying the dog run after grooming and being doted on by the staff, which gave me peace of mind.

There's a step at the entrance, and they helped me bring in with a stroller, but I feel like I'm bothering the staff every time I use the service, so that's the only thing I'm concerned about. However, the grooming itself was done beautifully, and I'm very satisfied.

This was my first time using the hotel, so I requested a daytime daycare as a trial beforehand.

I left my dog ​​for 6 hours, and I appreciate the frequent updates, including videos! Also, I had mentioned some concerns about leaving my dog ​​(communication with other dogs) when making the reservation, and the staff at check-in thoroughly reconfirmed these concerns, which made me feel confident about using the hotel again next time!

This was my first visit.

Because I was able to upload vaccination certificates and other documents digitally in advance, everything went smoothly on the day. I was happy to see so many cute photos on my profile page. I would like to use your services again.

The thorough consultation before dropping off my dog, along with the videos and daily log they sent me, made me feel very at ease even though it was my first time using their service for 3 hours. The staff were kind, and the shop was very clean.

I look forward to using their services again in the future! 🐶

I participated in a trial obedience class at a newly opened dog salon. I was very satisfied with the attentive service I received. They gave me detailed explanations! The staff had a great attitude, and I would like to use their services again in the future.

A new facility opened in our neighborhood, so we used their short-term stay service.

They seemed very thorough in checking my pet's medical history, which gave me peace of mind.

While they sent us a video update during my pet's stay, the photos were plentiful, but the daily log was rather brief, which was disappointing, so I've given it 4 stars.

This was my first time bringing my dog ​​in for grooming, and I was incredibly impressed by the polite and attentive service during the booking process, consultation, and after the grooming.
The grooming itself was done very carefully, and I'm so grateful that they contacted me midway through to check on any areas of concern and made adjustments on the spot.
The photos they gave me are also super cute, and I'm extremely happy with the result!

The staff were all very kind and provided excellent service.

My dog ​​seemed happy and enjoyed herself without any fuss, so I was able to leave her in their care with peace of mind.

I used to use a different branch, but after moving, it became too far away. I was so happy when one opened closer to me!

After each arrival, they send videos and photos, and the daily log is very detailed and thorough, so I feel completely at ease entrusting my child to them.

This is my first time using a school, but I'm really looking forward to seeing my child's progress.

This was my first time using their service.

I felt reassured knowing that they kept me updated throughout the grooming process.

I'd like to try their overnight service when I'm on a business trip abroad.
